content:
Aisha R: Going offline in ~45m — need someone to take primary for the overnight window. There's an active low-severity spike on embeddings-encoder; pages may continue. I can stay on phone if we need escalation. 

Tom H: I can take primary. Do you want me to also pick up secondary or leave Riley as secondary?

Aisha R: Leave Riley as secondary for now (they're booked until 03:00 PT). If the spike is still present after that we'll swap. Runbook link: https://redwood-docs/runbooks/encoder-spike (see "overnight-handback" section). Customer impact: 5–10% error rate on inference, latency up ~200–400ms on tail. Dashboard: Datadog -> embed-encoder -> error_rate.

oncall-bot: Alert: embeddings-encoder error rate > 4% for 12m — routed to primary.

Riley G: I can extend secondary coverage until 23:15 PT if needed but then I have a hard meeting. If Tom’s priming, I’ll be standby and can be promoted if Tom needs to rest.

Tom H: I'll take primary. @Sanjay K can you be secondary standby?

Sanjay K: Yep, standby as secondary. Post the short checklist and I’ll monitor.

Aisha R: Quick handoff checklist (copy/paste):
- Confirm primary/secondary names in PagerDuty and update rotation note.
- Check runbook top-of-run: mitigation steps, escalation matrix.
- Verify Grafana/DDB links are reachable and pinned.
- If scaling helps, follow autoscale override then revert after stability.
- Leave a 1-paragraph status in the incident channel when you hand back.

Tom H: Runbook quick commands I usually use:
```
# tail logs to see recent errors
kubectl logs -n inference svc/encoder -c worker --since=10m
# check pod restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=encoder -o wide
# bump replicas safely (do not exceed burst limit)
rexd scale encoder-prod --replicas=4
```

Aisha R: For mitigation steps: first try safe scale (to 4) and watch error rate for 10min. If errors persist, toggle feature-flag `encoder_v2_fallback` to route to v1. That flag is gated in LaunchDarkly: https://ld.redwood/flags/encoder_v2_fallback.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: encoder-service v2.3.1 by Tom H (canary -> 10% traffic)

Tom H: Doing a canary bump to 10% in prod now, then will scale to 4 if we see improvements. Will monitor Datadog and /metrics. If error rate > 8% after 10m we’ll rollback the canary and escalate to L2 on call.

oncall-bot: Incident severity: P2. Current summary: partial customer impact (some inference requests failing, degraded latency). Escalation: route to L2 if error rate > 15% for 10m.

Riley G: Logging into console and tailing logs. I’ll take over notification of any new pages during my extension window.

Aisha R: FYI I updated the runbook last on 2026-01-10 with the autoscale override step. Handback note will be in the runbook header.

Tom H: Primary handoff complete — I am primary until 08:00 PT. Summary: scaled to 4 replicas (safe bump), canary to v2.3.1 at 10% (no crash), error rate down to ~1.6% after scale. I’ll keep monitoring for 30m then annotate customer-impact doc. If anything else, page me (phone in profile). :thumbsup:
